parameters.name: Days
parameters.description:
The time range to query. Default value: 7. Unit: days.

> If daily automatic analysis has not started and manual analysis is not performed, no records are returned.

parameters.name: NodeId
parameters.description:
The ID of the child node in the cluster instance.

>  If you do not specify this parameter, the analysis results of all child nodes in the instance are returned.

parameters.name: PageNumbers
parameters.description: The number of the page to return.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: **30**, **50**, and **100**.

> The default value is **30**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun r-kvstore describe-cache-analysis-report-list --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --days 7 --page-size 30 --page-numbers 1 --node-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000-db-0 --region cn-hangzhou
